issues.issue: Should Her Majesty be struck as respondent, with the Minister and Solicitor General substituted?
issues.applicant_position: Consents to substituting the Minister and Solicitor General as respondents.
issues.respondent_position: Her Majesty was wrongly named; the Minister and Solicitor General issued the certificate.
issues.result_quote: the respondent's motion for an order striking Her Majesty the Queen as respondent and adding the Minister and Solicitor General is granted.

issues.issue: Can the designated judge's refusal to order further disclosure be appealed to the Federal Court of Appeal?
issues.applicant_position: Appeal lies under s. 27(1) Federal Court Act; s. 80(3) bars only appeals of the ultimate reasonableness ruling.
issues.respondent_position: Section 80(3) bars appeal of the whole reasonableness determination, including disclosure rulings under s. 78 (Tobiass).
issues.result_quote: is not subject to appeal in this Court pursuant to subsection 80(3) of the IRPA.

issues.issue: Should the reasonableness review be stayed pending the appeal on disclosure?
issues.applicant_position: Review should be stayed until the appeal on undisclosed evidence is decided.
issues.result_quote: his motion to stay the review of the certificate pending this appeal cannot succeed.

issues.issue: Should the reasonableness review be stayed pending the Ontario Court of Appeal challenge to the IRPA provisions?
issues.applicant_position: Review should wait for the Ontario appeal on the constitutionality of ss. 77-83 IRPA.
issues.result_quote: Mr. Zundel's motion to stay the review of the reasonableness of the certificate pending the hearing before the Ontario Court of Appeal should be dismissed.
